user_story: As a user, I want to receive an error when I try to reset the password with an unregistered email so that I know the email is not in the system.

positive.title: Successful password reset request with a registered email
steps: Navigate to the password reset page
positive.expected_result: A confirmation message is shown that a password reset email has been sent

negative.title: Password reset request with an unregistered email
steps: Navigate to the password reset page
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the email is not in the system

edge.title: Password reset request with an empty email field
steps: Navigate to the password reset page
Attempt to submit the password reset request
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email field cannot be empty

edge.title: Password reset request with an invalid email format
steps: Navigate to the password reset page
Enter an email with an invalid format
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the email format is invalid
